note: What scripts/art/export_sound.py writes into the mods, from the owner's picks (picks.json). reference is the game's SoundDef each sits beside, offset_db how far from its effective loudness (agent choices, explained in why), volume our SoundDef's volume (as the game reads it, out of 100). Levels measured with scripts/art/game_sounds.py on 10 Nov 2026.

exports.name: ConcentratorHum
exports.why: Biotech's hemopump is the nearest machine the game has: a medical pump that hums while it works. 3 dB quieter, because a concentrator sits beside sleeping patients.

exports.name: SwitchClick
exports.use: A physical switch on a vehicle or rig turned on or off
exports.why: The game's own toggle tick, matched by peak. The third of the three clicks (1.02 s) stands alone and decays cleanly; 2 dB under the tick, as a click has more body.
